title: LimonMobToggle
description: A lightweight mob toggle plugin available for free.
body:
# 🛡️ LimonMobToggle

LimonMobToggle is a lightweight server-side plugin that allows players to control hostile mob spawning in their world.

## ✨ What it does

The plugin lets players enable or disable mob spawning protection around their current location within a configurable radius. When enabled, hostile mobs are prevented from spawning in the area, and any existing hostile mobs inside the radius are automatically removed.

This helps create safe zones where players can build, survive, or explore without dealing with hostile mobs.

## 🎯 Why use it

It is useful for survival servers, towns, bases, or protected regions where players need peaceful areas without hostile creatures interfering with gameplay.

## ⌨️ Commands

- `/mobtoggle` → Enables or disables mob spawning protection in your current area.

## ⚙️ Features

- 🛡️ Toggle hostile mob spawning protection
- 🚫 Prevent mobs from spawning in a configurable radius
- 🧹 Automatically remove existing hostile mobs in the area
- 🌍 Support for disabled worlds
- ⚙️ Fully customizable messages and settings
- 🚀 Lightweight and optimized for performance

## 📦 Compatibility

Works with Bukkit-based servers:
- Paper
- Spigot
- Purpur

## 🍋 Notes

- Fully server-side plugin
- Radius and behavior configurable via config file
- Designed for simple setup and minimal performance impact
